release_notes: Buyer Log 7.0.193 TEST: PLM sample status is now robust to confusing PLM entries. If a sample type has an approved request, later unapproved re-entries (Evaluated / Received) are ignored. Sample stage chain: S/Off approval also approves PPS and Fit; PPS approval also approves Fit. Orders that have finished production (loading, shortage, in transit, customs, warehouse, awaiting retail transfer) are treated as sample-approved: the CP PLM Numune column shows a single "Approved · Post-production" badge and checklist sample questions close. Inferred approvals are explained in the tooltip.
